findings.title: Benchmark commands cannot distinguish the interventions
findings.description: The baseline and early-exit commands are identical, as are subdivision-only and combined commands. No revision selection or early-exit toggle distinguishes them. Consequently, this walkthrough cannot establish A2’s ≥5× improvement against the counter-gated baseline. Specify a baseline revision and reproducible comparison procedure; a permanent runtime toggle is unnecessary.

findings.title: Shared cell sizing is ambiguous for multiple profiles
findings.description: Slice 145 defines per-profile query radii and sizes the shared spatial grid using `max_query_radius`. This design instead derives its shared cell size from unspecified `query_radius`, while fixing traversal reach at S cells. Choosing a smaller profile’s radius would omit valid neighbors for larger-radius profiles, violating behavioral fidelity. Explicitly retain `cell_size = max_query_radius / S` and include a mixed-radius correctness case.

findings.title: The assigned seven-neighbor benchmark is missing
findings.description: The parent plan’s slice 149 entry explicitly identifies the seven-neighbor operating point as a benchmark target. This design specifies only `max_neighbors=32` gate runs. Add a measured seven-neighbor run alongside the existing stress configuration; it need not introduce another performance gate.
